result:
Round 324 (PERF-8b resume) is done: every granted row is complete and the tree is ready for C. One item needs B's ruling: claim K19 comes out at 4 where the task expects at least 5. I put a STOP at the top of `a-round-324.md` for it, and a note telling C to run all rows anyway.

**Why K19 is 4:** K19 counts lines in the budgets file that contain `"interact.select`. §2.5 defines five rows, but the live row's id is `interact.harness.select-same-lane-live`, which doesn't contain that text. With the ids written exactly as specified, the count is 4. I didn't rename or add anything to make the grep pass. B can either accept 4 or change K19 to count the five ids. Nothing else depends on this value.

**What changed** (all within the grants):
- **`render-budget.test.tsx`:** the §1 edit, applied exactly as in the patch file. `expect(` count goes from 88 to 92. Only two HEAD asserts changed (R9-L2 and R11-P1e), each with a positive control kept in the same test.
- **New `selection-wrappers-render.test.tsx` (SS8a/SS8b):** it copies the code it needs and imports from neither source test file.
- **New `selection-store.test.tsx` (SS1–SS7).**
- **Perf harness:** a new last step in the 30-clip block plus the 5 budget rows (additions only). The step presses "-" until two clip name bars are visible (at most 16 presses). Without this, the first real run found only one 4054 px clip on screen and the step failed.
- **Docs 230, 231 and 168:** both status lines read exactly `Completed (C round 324 PASS)`.
- **`ArrangementContext.tsx` and `StudioWorkspace.tsx`:** Biome had flagged unsorted imports (round-322 placement), so I sorted them. These are pure order moves.

**Results:**
- **Unit tests:** 113/113 files, 1714/1714 tests, run again after the last code change. `perf/lib/report.test.ts` passes 34/34. No test is above 50 % of its timeout.
- **Mutants:** all six turn their rows red on a scratch copy, and SS8b stays green under MU-GROUP-HEADER-NO-MEMO. The scratch was restored.
- **Expect counts:** identical to HEAD for the 29 files.
- **Typecheck and lint:** typecheck rc 0, lint rc 0, Biome clean on the 37 owned app and test files.
- **A-PERF (production builds, run alone):** both runs had no failures. The re-review edits came after this run; they sit outside the measured windows, and C's run uses the final spec.

  | Row | HEAD control | A |
  |---|---|---|
  | Same-lane click, components | 107 | 25 |
  | Re-click | 2 commits, 92 components | 1 commit, 0 components |
  | Click / fade-trim-move drags | baseline | +3 / about +2 per move |

  A name probe shows the extra renders are only the selection subscriber components, once each per commit. That is within the round-323 tolerance.
- **Code review:** four passes. The first two flagged one Medium each; the second (lost diagnostics when the zoom limit is hit) is fixed. The first pass's Medium (an assert row that had never run, plus a doc placeholder) is handled: A-PERF now runs that row, and the placeholder holds the measured numbers. The last two passes found nothing. Reviewer Lows and two architecture notes are passed to B as proposals; I didn't refactor anything.
- **Claims after:** everything matches §5 except K19. K43 is 8 rather than 9 because Biome wraps one of the two new positive-control lines, so the single-line grep misses it.

I did not run the gate rows (full suite, build, verify, e2e smoke) or C's browser rows. A-CLAIMS-AFTER is not passed, and PERF-8b and the backlog are not complete. The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-324.md`, with logs, probes and mutant results in `a-round-324/`.
